Targeted web searches (category + New Brunswick NJ) surfacing Yellow Pages, Superpages, Cylex, Birdeye, BBB, LoopNet, Realtor.com, IRS, Justia/Lawyers.com, Super Lawyers, Martindale, county bar association, design-professional PDFs and firm websites

categories_thin: Land surveying - one New Brunswick-based firm (Professional Land Services); most surveyors covering the city are based in Piscataway or Flemington.
Real estate appraisal - one local firm (Thompson Appraisal Service) and it is directory-only; most appraisers serving the city are in Edison/Franklin.
Title agencies - two New Brunswick addresses only; several 'New Brunswick title company' web pages belong to agencies based elsewhere and were excluded.
Environmental consulting - only Aguilar Environmental is New Brunswick-based; the national consultancies with local offices were excluded under the size rule stated in caveats.
Financial advisory - difficult to separate real New Brunswick offices from advisors at shared/virtual addresses on George St; bank-owned brokerage platforms were excluded, so the category is thin.

Legal - extremely dense (dozens of sole practitioners). Four Livingston Ave law firms were recovered in revision, but more almost certainly exist inside the 303/317 George St, 46 Bayard St and 40 Paterson St suites that no public directory fully indexes; several directory-only names at 53 and 77 Paterson St could not be re-verified and were dropped.
caveats: Zone check: all of New Brunswick NJ sits roughly 4-5 miles straight-line from central Milltown (40.4498,-74.4407), so the entire town is inside the 10-mile radius; no part of the zone falls outside it.

317 George St (especially Suite 320 and Suite 412) and 100/120 Albany St are multi-tenant or virtual-office buildings; the Suite 320 rows (Brach Eichler, Leon Matchin, Shaw Divorce & Family Law, Adam C Brown, Easy Prep Tax, Comprehensive Wealth Strategies) are FLAGGED as unverified staffing - confirm a person answers locally before outreach.

Size rule applied consistently in revision: national/global firms are excluded even where they have a New Brunswick branch, so Slalom, TRC Companies, CBIZ, CGI, TIAA, Elkus Manfredi and the J.P. Morgan/Morgan Stanley branch offices were dropped or never listed. Regional and mid-size firms (Windels Marx, Hoagland Longo, Brach Eichler, Brandon J. Broderick, Ginarte) are kept and flagged where their size at the site is unverified.

Excluded as chains/franchises: State Farm agent offices (including the 142 Livingston Ave office that markets on insurance08901.com), Coldwell Banker and RE/MAX franchise offices, Spherion and PeopleReady, and Central Jersey Legal Services (nonprofit legal aid).

Twelve rows were removed during revision after checking the businesses' own sites or public records: Arons & Arons (firm is in South Orange), Castronovo and McKinney (Morristown), Hannum Feretic (Secaucus), Deutchman & Drews (Somerville office on the firm's own contact page), Ronaldo C. George (disbarred by consent, effective July 2024), Feeney Law Office (no verifiable record beyond a 403-blocked directory), The Harrison Group (Milltown mailing address, outside this zone), Richmond Asset Management (bank-owned brokerage platform), Slalom, TRC Companies, and two chamber-number rows that were corrected rather than removed.

Several entries still come from a single bulk directory (Yellow Pages/Superpages/Cylex/LoopNet/FindOpen/firmania/loc8nearme) and were not confirmed on an own website; active_evidence marks these as 'one directory only'.
Only published business contact details were collected - no personal names, home addresses or personal phone numbers.
data_gaps: AllPages' New Brunswick attorneys page returns HTTP 403 to direct fetching, so it cannot be cited; every row that rested on it was re-verified elsewhere, corrected, or removed in this revision.
Several sites also return HTTP 403 (ams tech solutions, Justia, Yellow Pages, BBB, Superpages, Manta); their data was used only through search-result summaries and is labelled as such.

AMS Technical Solutions (21 Kilmer Rd) was dropped: its site is 403 so the address could not be read directly, the published 08906 ZIP is a New Brunswick PO-box ZIP, and Kilmer Rd straddles the Edison line - municipality unconfirmed. A 732-305-6310 number appears in search results for it; the firm is worth re-checking if the team can confirm the town.

Overpass/OSM: the earlier citation was not a runnable query URL, so OSM-derived rows were replaced with firm-side sources. The primary Overpass endpoint was unreachable from this machine and mirrors timed out on large office=* queries, so OSM coverage remains incomplete.

Google and Bing Maps were read as a visitor only; no signed-in map session was possible, so categories that exist only as map listings (some sole practitioners, small property managers) may still be missing.
Addresses could not be verified for Penn Properties Management, New Brunswick Property Management LLC, Bussel Realty Corp, VensIT Corp, Yonta Law, Cintron Firm, AM Media and North Star Media Group.
The city's shop-local listing site (newbrunswick.com) is fetchable per business but its category index URL could not be located, so it was not mined in bulk.
Frazer Evangelista (CPA) and Overmyer Insurance Agency appear in chamber/New Brunswick listings but their own sites place them in East Brunswick and Cranford respectively, so they were not listed.
